_doc: The anchor registry. One name for one control, whichever surface it is on.
product   the control exists once in a real template; data-a="key" must be
pattern   the control exists once PER RECORD. The template emits the key
with t-attf-data-a, so the registry declares the prefix and the
test looks for that prefix rather than a literal key.
practice  a TEACHING view with no product counterpart — an arithmetic
breakdown, a lifecycle stepper. It exists only on the practice
replica. Declared so the gap is visible: Phase 2's Coach must
never claim to point at one of these on a live screen.
every product/pattern key exists in its template · every practice key
exists in the replica · every data-a in a scanned file is declared here.

cc-catchment.desc: The catchment pill. Every count on the wall is scoped by it.

cc-wall.desc: The triage wall — one tile per person, most urgent first.

cc-claim.desc: The unclaimed banner and its Claim button.

cc-actions.desc: The action strip: the doors out of a conversation.

cc-composer.desc: The reply box. What is typed here cannot be recalled.

cc-consent.desc: Consent. The check before answering a clinical question to a relative.

cc-escalate.desc: Escalate. Needs a lead on the conversation.

cc-junk.desc: Junk. Risky action — also marks the contact and flags the number.

ch-checks.desc: Readiness checks. 'Connected' is derived from these, never typed in.

db-period.desc: The period selector every figure on the screen is filtered by.
db-period.practice_only_note: The real selector lives in the dashboard header; declared as product because the tutorial points at it.

cc-row-.desc: One wall tile per conversation; the suffix is the conversation id.

cc-watch-.desc: The watch-phrase flag on the open thread; suffix is the conversation id.

db-.desc: One KPI tile per card; the suffix is the product's own KPI key.

ch-card-.desc: One card per channel; the suffix is the channel key.

cc-tabs.desc: Attention / Leads / All tabs on the replica.

cc-release.desc: The Claim button inside the replica's claim bar.

cc-pipeline.desc: Conversation lifecycle stepper — a teaching view.

cc-score-4172.desc: Urgency breakdown panel for the worked case.

cc-term-watch.desc: The watch-phrase term inside that breakdown.

ch-pipeline.desc: Connection lifecycle stepper — a teaching view.

ch-wall-hn.desc: Per-area wall volumes, to show where traffic lands.

ch-area-zalo-hn.desc: The area line on the Hà Nội Zalo card. The replica models two OAs as two cards; the product groups them under one channel card with accounts inside, so this has no 1:1 product control.

ch-card-zalo-hn.desc: Replica card for the Hà Nội OA (see ch-area-zalo-hn).

ch-card-zalo-hcm.desc: Replica card for the TPHCM OA.

ch-reauth.desc: Re-authorise on the replica's Hà Nội card.

ch-disable.desc: Disconnect on the replica's Hà Nội card.

ur-dismiss.desc: Dismiss — an answer, recorded against your name.

co-tabs.desc: Lifecycle status tabs on the contact list.

co-book.desc: Book — opens the wizard with the duplicate check.

co-pipeline.desc: Contact lifecycle stepper — a teaching view.

ac-filter.desc: The date filter. Overdue items are NOT inside Today.

la-total.desc: The totals row that must reconcile with the Dashboard.

db-pipeline.desc: Contact pipeline donut and its reconciliation line.
